name: Epoch AI
scope: Chip ownership, users and large AI data centers
strength: Open datasets, uncertainty models and dated site evidence
ours: Uses and credits Epoch; joins selected fleets to contracts, prices and financial growth. Not a replacement for its original model.

name: SemiAnalysis / ClusterMAX
scope: Provider quality, construction pipeline and compute economics
strength: Cluster testing and specialist commercial models; public rental and cost tools
ours: Combines public facts and short attributed estimates. Does not claim to have independently tested provider reliability or to reproduce the proprietary models.

name: AI Compute Tracker
scope: Cloud, chip, facility, finance and power agreements
strength: Dated deal ledger, claim types, source details, changes and CSV download
ours: Adds a relationship diagram and common-axis financial growth. Adopts explicit deal types, source comparison and downloads rather than claiming greater completeness.

name: American Compute
scope: Offtake, financing, credit and GPU risk
strength: Contract concentration, financing structures and unit economics
ours: Connects selected contracts to fleet and market-price context. Has no independent credit underwriting or physical GPU appraisal.

name: Data Center Census
scope: Projects, capacity, permits and neocloud comparisons
strength: Site maps, local evidence, change tracking and downloadable data
ours: Shows selected company totals and documented-site subtotals. Not a comprehensive site map or a substitute for local permit records.

name: Compute.World
scope: Regional GPU providers and silicon availability
strength: Location granularity, regional filters and machine-readable records
ours: Includes Chinese clouds and accelerator families in one narrative. Regional availability remains less detailed.

name: Compute Desk / Silicon Data / SemiAnalysis prices
scope: Rental benchmarks and contract survey ranges
strength: Purpose-built time series with explicit market definitions
ours: Puts their distinct benchmarks beside retail rate cards. Does not merge them into a new market index or imply they are directly bookable prices.
